purpose: Verify that future formal runs launched from the clean Spark clone produce auditable and scientifically eligible artifacts.

mechanism_observation.interpretation: The Agent had solved the scoring residual before delivery but still had to infer the goal-specific Pass from a Pyright process that exited nonzero because 200 non-scoring diagnostics remained. This supports testing an exact current-goal observation followed by programization and clean replay; it is not an effectiveness result.

claim_boundary: This smoke validates the clean-source experiment path only. It is excluded from paired algorithm-effect and leaderboard estimates.
